title: BACE: Biochemistry & Molecular Biology - Biochemistry & Molecular Biology - Central Dogma
subject: Biochemistry & Molecular Biology

questions.q: According to the Central Dogma of molecular biology, which of the following represents the typical flow of genetic information?
questions.explain: The Central Dogma describes the flow of genetic information within a biological system: DNA is transcribed into RNA, which is then translated into Protein ($DNA \rightarrow RNA \rightarrow Protein$).
questions.subject: Biochemistry & Molecular Biology

questions.q: Which of the following modifications occurs at the 5' end of eukaryotic mRNA during processing?
questions.explain: Eukaryotic mRNA is modified at the 5' end by the addition of a 7-methylguanosine cap (5' cap), which protects the mRNA from degradation and assists in translation initiation.
questions.subject: Biochemistry & Molecular Biology

questions.q: Which molecule acts as the adapter that translates the nucleotide sequence of mRNA into the amino acid sequence of a protein?
questions.explain: Transfer RNA (tRNA) serves as the adapter molecule. It carries a specific amino acid at one end and has an anticodon at the other that pairs with the complementary codon on the mRNA.
questions.subject: Biochemistry & Molecular Biology

questions.q: If a DNA coding strand has the sequence $5'-ATG\ CCG\ TAA-3'$, what is the corresponding mRNA sequence?
questions.explain: The mRNA sequence is identical to the coding (non-template) strand of DNA, except that Thymine (T) is replaced by Uracil (U). Thus, $5'-ATG\ CCG\ TAA-3'$ becomes $5'-AUG\ CCG\ UAA-3'$.
questions.subject: Biochemistry & Molecular Biology

questions.q: What is the function of the ribosome's P-site during translation?
options: It holds the tRNA carrying the growing polypeptide chain.
It is the exit site for the uncharged tRNA.
questions.explain: The P-site (Peptidyl site) holds the tRNA that is linked to the growing polypeptide chain. The A-site binds the new aminoacyl-tRNA, and the E-site is where empty tRNAs exit.
questions.subject: Biochemistry & Molecular Biology

questions.q: Which enzyme is responsible for synthesizing mRNA during transcription in eukaryotes?
questions.explain: In eukaryotes, RNA Polymerase II is the specific polymerase responsible for synthesizing precursors of mRNA (and most snRNA/microRNA). Pol I synthesizes rRNA, and Pol III synthesizes tRNA.
